newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open higher on follow-through buying.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open higher on follow-through buying.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened slightly higher on Wednesday, as bullish sentiment was carried over from the previous day, brokers said.
They said the Nikkei average had bottomed out last week and that the index would now be supported above 21,000.
The key 225-share Nikkei average was up 12.37 points or 0.06 percent at 21,442.30 in the first 15 minutes of trading. Its December futures were 30 points higher at 21,520.
"The Nikkei average is not likely to fall below 21,000 for the time being," said a broker at a major Japanese securities house.
